stem.text: A metal cube has a resistance of $4.0\,\Omega$ between opposite faces.
Ten of these cubes are put together to make a cuboid of $1 \times 2 \times 5$ cubes.

stem.alt: Drawing of a cuboid made of ten cubes, in two rows of five, seen from the front, with the cube edges marked.
Drawing of a cuboid with dashed edges at the back, with the points X and Y marked on its left and right end faces.

stem.text: There is no extra resistance where the faces of the cubes touch each other.
What is the resistance of the cuboid when connected between faces X and Y?
